# Just Canvass

> Just Canvass is canvassing software and a door-to-door door-knocking app — political campaign software built in Canada for Canadian municipal election campaigns. Door knocking is its core: real-time mapping, instant sync, and live team tracking as canvassers knock. It also gives independent candidates, slates, and local campaigns the same broader ground-game tools as major political parties — phonebanking, text blasts, email campaigns, robocalls, sign management, GOTV, and real-time analytics — all in one platform. Districts and voter data are pre-loaded across Canada: British Columbia, Ontario, and Manitoba are in their active general municipal election cycle, while Alberta and other provinces are available for by-elections, candidate organizing, and upcoming municipal cycles.

Key facts:

- Product: canvassing software and door-knocking app — political campaign software for political campaigns. Three ways to get it: a native Android app on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.justcanvass.android), an iPhone/iPad app currently in App Store review, and a mobile-first web app at app.justcanvass.ca that runs in any browser and installs to the home screen from Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android). Get the app: https://www.justcanvass.ca/download/
- Best for: candidates and campaigns that want a focused door-knocking / door-to-door canvassing app and the option to run phone, text, email, and GOTV from the same place
- Made for: Canadian municipal elections (mayor, council, school board trustee), including the 2026 municipal election cycle; supports single candidates and multi-candidate slates
- Coverage: pre-loaded electoral districts across Canada — British Columbia, Ontario, and Manitoba are in their active general municipal election cycle right now; Alberta and additional provinces are available for by-elections, candidate organizing, petitions, and upcoming municipal cycles. Campaigns do not need to bring their own voter list to get started
- Features: door-to-door canvassing, sign management, text blasts, email campaigns, phonebanking, robocalls, GOTV integration, smart area selection, real-time analytics, heat maps, historical election results and census data, role-based team access, mobile-first design with seamless sync
- Integrations: Squarespace, Wix, NationBuilder, CallHub, Google Sheets, Go High Level, Quo, and Stripe; new integrations are built at the request of a campaign
- Pricing: custom quotes only — every quote is tailored to the level of government, district size, location, and typical campaign spend for the contest (e.g., a Toronto council seat is quoted differently than a small-town mayoral race). All quotes include unlimited contacts and users. Request a quote at hello@justcanvass.ca
- Contact: hello@justcanvass.ca, +1-780-965-1195
- Company: Just Canvass Solutions Ltd., a Canadian company with real Canadian campaign experience

- [Home](https://www.justcanvass.ca/): product overview, features, coverage, integrations, and pricing
- [Key Features](https://www.justcanvass.ca/#features): full feature list for canvassing, outreach, and analytics tools
- [Coverage](https://www.justcanvass.ca/#canada-focus): supported provinces and 2026 municipal election readiness
- [Integrations](https://www.justcanvass.ca/#integrations): platforms Just Canvass connects with
- [Pricing](https://www.justcanvass.ca/#pricing): how custom campaign quotes work and how to request one
- [Get a Quote & Demo](https://www.justcanvass.ca/#quote): request form for a tailored quote and personal demo (name, email, postal code, position)
- [Get the App](https://www.justcanvass.ca/download/): Google Play badge for Android, App Store status for iPhone (in review), and the browser install — step-by-step home-screen instructions for Chrome on Android, Safari on iOS 18+, and Safari on iOS 12–17 — plus a copy-paste line campaigns can send to volunteers
- [Best Canvassing Apps for Canadian Campaigns](https://www.justcanvass.ca/best-canvassing-app/): honest 2026 comparison of the best canvassing apps for Canadian municipal campaigns — Just Canvass vs Ecanvasser, Qomon, and Campaign Knock — with a side-by-side feature table and FAQ; NationBuilder and CallHub noted as complementary (non-canvassing) integration partners
- [Campaign app login](https://app.justcanvass.ca/): sign in to the Just Canvass campaign dashboard

## Blog

- [Blog & Campaign Guides](https://www.justcanvass.ca/blog/): guides and resources for Canadian municipal campaigns — election dates, canvassing how-tos, compliance, and GOTV
- [2026 Canadian Municipal Election Dates & Deadlines](https://www.justcanvass.ca/blog/2026-canadian-municipal-election-dates/): election day, nomination periods, filing deadlines and fees for the 2026 municipal elections in Ontario (Oct 26), British Columbia (Oct 17) and Manitoba (Oct 28), plus a candidate campaign timeline
- [2026 Ontario Municipal Election: Dates & Candidate Guide](https://www.justcanvass.ca/blog/2026-ontario-municipal-election/): Ontario-specific deep dive — Oct 26, 2026 election day, the May 1–August 21 nomination period, filing fees, and the 25-signature endorsement rule
- [2026 BC Municipal Election: Local Election Dates & Candidate Guide](https://www.justcanvass.ca/blog/2026-bc-municipal-election/): British Columbia-specific deep dive — Oct 17, 2026 general local elections, the short Sep 1–11 nomination window, eligibility, and Elections BC campaign-finance and disclosure rules
- [2026 Manitoba Municipal Election: Dates & Candidate Guide](https://www.justcanvass.ca/blog/2026-manitoba-municipal-election/): Manitoba-specific deep dive — Oct 28, 2026 election day, Winnipeg candidate registration windows and the 250-signature mayoral requirement, plus how municipalities outside Winnipeg differ
- [2025 Alberta Municipal Election Dates & Deadlines](https://www.justcanvass.ca/blog/2025-alberta-municipal-election-dates/): election day (Oct 20, 2025), nomination day, notice of intent to run, and campaign disclosure deadlines from Alberta's 2025 general municipal election, plus what's next before the 2029 cycle
